range_convention: Observed source ranges include both endpoints. Derived unions, envelopes and differences use exclusive stop addresses. Counts are byte-address counts, not instruction counts.
limitations: This reports stored Ghidra metadata, not a proof that real function or operation bodies have been completely recognized.
Singleton bodies remain unverified database annotations; they are not certified one-byte functions.
Bytes outside the stored union may be padding, data, other code, or genuine missing operation blocks; they are not automatically nonowned.
All five previously identified conditional-path gaps remain open regardless of equality with current stored ranges.
No current Listing/PE-byte validation, function repair, original-byte mutation, decompilation or runtime observation was performed by this join.
